title: FLASH: Fast Learning via GPU-Accelerated Simulation for High-Fidelity Deformable Manipulation in Minutes
abstract: FLASH is a GPU-native simulation framework for contact-rich deformable manipulation, built on an accurate NCP-based non-smooth Newton solver designed for fine-grained GPU parallelism. Rather than porting SIMD solvers to GPUs, FLASH redesigns the physics engine from the ground up, with an inertia-dominated contact approximation that keeps the Schur complement sparse and enables block-diagonal multi-environment batching. It scales to 3M+ DoF at 30 FPS on a single RTX 5090 (100-300x speedup vs realtime). Vision-based policies trained solely on FLASH synthetic data in minutes achieve robust zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on towel and garment folding without any real-world demonstration.
